x: This was succeeded by the two miles race, and in this D. Christie-Murray (S.W.C.) set a terrific pace, with Harry Churcher in pursuit.
Charlie Churcher, our Captain, distinguished himself by finishing third in his first attempt at this distance, being only 2 mins. 23 secs. behind the winner, D.

Bridger as lack of distance training began to tell, dispelled our chances, despite the splendid "second-half" of Jack Bidgood, who eventually finished third. The winner, D. Christie-Murray (S.W.C.) was well away from the others at the finish and recorded 2 hrs. 38 min. 17 sec. for the distance.
Staker in fast time, and D. Christie-Murray, the Surrey W.C. and Oxford University athlete, finished second, with A.
